commits.translation: 科学文档结合了连续的散文、方程式、表格、参考文献和技术术语。一个有用的阅读助手应该在保留文档的原始意义和结构的同时，将散文进行翻译。研究人员经常多次阅读同一段落，以理解一个不熟悉的方法，并将其与早期的工作进行比较。本地语言模型可以在不将文档发送到远程服务的情况下支持这一过程。它们的实际速度取决于内存带宽、处理器指令、工人线程和正在处理的上下文量。一个简短的答案可能在处理器达到稳定的操作状态之前就完成，因此重复的测量与更长的输出是有用的。提示处理和令牌生成应该单独测量，因为它们执行不同的计算。公平的比较还记录了确切的模型文件、推理设置和设备条件。这个实验的目标是产生一个忠实的中文翻译，并保留足够的时间信息，以区分引擎性能和应用程序开销。

nativeCalls.user:
English: Scientific documents combine continuous prose with equations, tables, references, and technical terminology. A useful reading assistant should translate the prose while preserving the original meaning and the structure of the document. Researchers often read the same paragraph several times to understand an unfamiliar method and compare it with earlier work. Local language models can support this process without sending the document to a remote service. Their practical speed depends on memory bandwidth, processor instructions, worker threads, and the amount of context being processed. A short answer may finish before the processor reaches a steady operating state, so repeated measurements with longer outputs are useful. Prompt processing and token generation should be measured separately because they perform different kinds of computation. A fair comparison also records the exact model file, inference settings, and device conditions. The goal of this experiment is to produce a faithful Chinese translation and retain enough timing information to distinguish engine performance from application overhead.
